details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B is the base (pretrained, non-instruction-tuned) checkpoint in Alibaba's Qwen2.5-Coder family: a 7.61-billion-parameter (6.53B non-embedding) transformer with grouped-query attention across 28 layers, trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data. Released by Qwen in September 2024 under an Apache 2.0 license, it is meant as a foundation for further fine-tuning rather than direct conversational use; Qwen's own model card advises against using base language models for conversations without post-training such as SFT or RLHF.
advantages: Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens including source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, per Qwen's model card.
Native context extendable up to 131,072 tokens via YaRN scaling beyond its 32,768-token base, per Qwen's model card.
Apache 2.0 licensed, permitting broader commercial use than the Qwen Research-licensed 3B size in the same family, per Qwen's model card.
disadvantages: This is a base, non-instruction-tuned checkpoint; Qwen's model card states base language models are not recommended for conversations without further post-training.
Text-only; Qwen's model card and the catalog facts list no vision or audio input.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or RLHF into custom coding assistants
Foundation for building coding agents, per Qwen's model card

notes: No numeric benchmark scores for this specific 7B size are shown in text on Qwen's model card or the Qwen2.5-Coder blog (the blog only shows size-vs-score charts, not tabulated numbers), so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. Qwen's GitHub repo for Qwen2.5-Coder now redirects (HTTP 301) to QwenLM/Qwen3-Coder, so no working github_url could be confirmed; left null. Facts show a 32,768-token context which matches Qwen's stated base config for this size.
